build_calibration_dataloader: build a calibration dataloader from a tokenizer and dataset name using get_dataloader
create_calibration_dataset: create a calibration dataset for model quantization using get_dataset with a specified tokenizer and sequence length
register_custom_dataset: register a custom dataset loader function using the register_dataset decorator for calibration
apply_chat_template: apply a chat template to text samples using apply_chat_template_to_samples with a tokenizer
load_local_dataset: load a local JSON or JSONL file as a calibration dataset using get_local_dataset
